_comment: Copy to project_builder.json and edit for THIS machine. All keys are optional — omit any and the engine falls back to a sensible default (env vars ABLETON_TEMPLATE_PATH / ABLETON_OUTPUT_BASE / PYTHON_ML_EXE / ENABLE_ML_CLASSIFIER / ML_TIMEOUT_SEC override both). project_builder.json is gitignored so machines don't clobber each other's paths.
